title: The Latest Crier for Oct 16, 2026
items:
Murder Mystery Party - free for all students!

SSS & CAB are having a Halloween Murder Mystery in the Graham Annex at 7:30 pm on Thursday, October 29. You can choose to have a part in this fun mystery or just try to solve the murder with your friends! Enjoy hot cider, popcorn, and pumpkin bars! 

Limit to 25 students - reserve your spot NOW! 

RSVP to diehlm@central.edu

Fellowship of Christian Athletes - Upcoming Weeks

Next Week: 
FCA will not be meeting next Tuesday, 10/20 , due to fall break. Enjoy your long weekend to reset! 

The Following Week: Volunteer Night 

The following Tuesday, 10/27 , FCA will be doing a volunteer night at The Well from 7:30-8:30pm instead of our regular gathering. Use the following link to sign up to serve: 

https://central4-my.sharepoint.com/:x:/g/personal/bensonp1_central_edu/IQBYFmcL1qMdSLQmWa-4zCMtAVHTRXgwlhIc3Mv9VUQXSqk?e=ZARqRK 

Have a great week! 

- FCA Leadership Team

Costumes, Karaoke, and Cash Bar!

Join us for a Halloween party on Friday, October 30th from 9-11 pm in the BMW rooms (1st floor of Maytag). We'll have karaoke , a costume contest , snacks , and a cash bar for those 21 and older. Cash prizes will be awarded to the winners!

Big Red Mascot Student Position

You could work a normal campus job... OR you could be Big Red! 
Central is looking for students to join the Big Red team as Big Red mascots and handlers for the 2026-2027 school year! 

Interested? Apply Here!

The St. Mary's Catholic Church shuttle bus will NOT run this Sunday 10-18-26

The shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will NOT run this Sunday 10/18/26. The Shuttle Bus will resume service on Sunday October 25, 2026, have a great Fall Break. 
If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu.
